LESSON: READING 14.2.1 STUDY SKILLS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 14
Topic 14.2: Reading 14.2.1 Study Skills
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 14.2.1 Study Skills, part of Strand 14 in Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to summarise information? 2. How can key points be identified in a text?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Learning to learn: It is achieved as the learner engages in self-driven tasks by displaying their paragraphs for peer review.

• Self-efficacy: It is enhanced as the learner identifies what they find confusing while making notes and writing summaries.

Values:
Unity: It is fostered as the learner collaborates with peers to identify main ideas brought out in texts.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Safety: It is promoted as the learner reads a text on safety in sports and identifies key points.

Links to other Learning Areas:
Note making and summary writing skills are important in all subjects such as Religious Education and Integrated Science.
